rules: TS_DELTA($close, w) as a standalone or multiplied-in displacement leg failed cheap_screen 4x this round (|t| 0.08-0.56, incl. ABS(TS_DELTA($close,15))/range and two CS_RANK(TS_DELTA($close,3))*... variants); TS_DELTA($volume,3) played the same 'delta ingredient' role inside 2 accepts (1.383, 0.867) instead — prefer volume deltas over close deltas.

Wrapping only the volume argument of an already-archived TS_CORR(x, $volume, w) in TS_RANK does not decorrelate: TS_CORR(TS_STD($return,5), TS_RANK($volume,21), 21) hit rho 0.857 and TS_CORR(TS_RANK($volume,10), $high-$low, 10) hit rho 0.809, both against raw-$volume archive parents with different partner terms and windows.

TS_STD($high-$low,63)/(TS_STD($high-$low,5)+1e-8) alone failed cheap_screen (|t| 0.86) — this vol-term-structure ratio only cleared before when crossed with a momentum/delta multiplier (prior 6.583 accept); don't resubmit the bare ratio.
$return-driven kernels failed cheap_screen again this round (TS_CORR($return,...) 0.26, ABS($return)*TS_DELTA(TS_RANK($volume,...),...) 0.42) — still the weakest primary leg available.

TS_RANK($high-$low,21) is archive-blocked under any outer wrapper (collided both inside a CS_RANK($accrual_gap)* product and inside a TS_CORR(...,126) with volume rank); the stochastic ($close-TS_MIN($low,21))/(X($high,21)-TS_MIN($low,21)) chassis is now closed for X = TS_MAX or EMA. Move to a different window or range statistic, not a smoothing-function swap.

RANK($earnings_per_share) - RANK(TS_RANK($dollar_volume,63)) was this round's best fitness (3.713) — nesting TS_RANK inside the non-fundamental leg of a rank-spread still clears correlation against flatter versions; this template still has room.
CS_RANK($roa) * TS_RANK($high-$low,5) scored 3.149 (2nd best) — short-window (5-day) range-rank crossed with a fundamental rank is still open, unlike the saturated 21/63-day range windows.
3 of 20 rejects (15%) this round were exact within-run duplicates — diff new proposals against the full batch already proposed this run, not just the archive.
